correctness.rationale: Unsigned incidence B of balanced complete multipartite G gives L_line=2d I-BᵀB and signless Q=BBᵀ spectrum 2d(1), (r-2)k(r-1), d(r(k-1)). Therefore maximal kernel dimension q=m-n gives actuator lower bound. For complement F of n edges PBH kernel condition is nonsingular B_F iff each component is odd-unicyclic. Dense selected-edge S then has trivial Q-eigenspace PBH obstruction except the K_{2,2,2} two-triangle case. Independent complete 924-complement enumeration there found 500 odd-unicyclic candidates and exactly 496 controllable, four excluded. Cauchy–Binet yields sum 4^{c(F)}=det Q and -64 correction. Infinite assertion relies on graph-cut bounds/equality argument, not the base enumeration.
